learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should trigger automatic retry logic before marking files as inconclusive
When critical files like PKGBUILD fail to audit, the system should escalate to a stronger model or retry with exponential backoff
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool failure' and 'inconclusive due to genuine uncertainty' in verdict reporting
The audit tool should validate that all critical files (PKGBUILD, .install hooks) were successfully reviewed before producing a final verdict
